high_level_description: This image captures a celebratory moment at the Nasdaq stock exchange. The setting is vibrant and dynamic, with a large screen displaying stock market information in the background. The screen shows various company logos and stock prices, including PepsiCo (PEP), Apple (AAPL), Starbucks (SBUX), Amazon (AMZN), and PayPal (PYPL). The Nasdaq logo is prominently displayed on the screen. In the foreground, a group of individuals is gathered around a podium. The central figure, a man with gray hair and a beard, is dressed in a dark suit and white shirt. He is smiling broadly and waving to the crowd
